title: A dead Linux helper fails one command, not the Pi process
hypothesis: launch_browser wrote to the Linux helper's stdin with no error listener; an unstartable bridge raised EPIPE unhandled and killed the whole trial.
measurement: 3 component tests; removing the listeners reproduces the production 'Error: write EPIPE'. Archive contract 11/11, 16 benchmark-runner tests and 11 adapter tests pass on the rebased branch. Sandbox rerun: the tool returns isError and the trial is scored.
result: child stdin/stdout/stderr get error listeners that reject pending commands. Shipped as @injaneity/pi-computer-use 0.5.1-rotom.11; only that file and the version differ from .rotom.10, native prebuilt bytes reused.
